The '''H-10''' was a type of small [[shuttle]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], designed primarily for short intra-system trips, and sometimes referred to as a [[brig (ship type)|brig]].<ref name="Planet of Twilight" />

The design was very compact, with room for just six typical [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] including the flight crew, and no enclosed storage compartments of any size.<ref name="Planet of Twilight" />

Originally designed as a [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transport]], the H-10 was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] before the advent of the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]], and subsequently achieved a second lease of popularity as a civilian vehicle in remote parts of the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]], widely used by both under-resourced [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] governments and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="H-10" />

The H-10 was ubiquitous enough that in his youth on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had stripped down and reassembled several transports of this type. By the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], they were considered relatively antiquated, but they remained prevalent as a short-range transport in outlying systems, albeit supported in the role by newer models of Sienar brig.<ref name="Planet of Twilight" />

[[Seti Ashgad/Legends|Seti Ashgad]] used a Sienar H-10 on [[Nam Chorios]].<ref name="Planet of Twilight" />
